content: Nabii Yakub i Bhanuana Laban
Sapadhana sumai Yakub abhosemo minaaka iwe sumai tee alingka i Tana Mesopotamia, i weta i timbuna Kanaan, o lipuna inana.

Wakutuuna incia akamakamata kadhaangia i saripina, akamatamo dhaangia saangu sumu i tana mokorumpu. I saripina sumu sumai dhaangia talu gulumana bhembe dumba tangasaana apotidhole, roonamo minaaka iwe sumaimo mia kananeana adhawu sumpu kadhambaakana. Dhaangia saangu bhatu maoge motutubhina ngangana sumu sumai.

Ande bhari-bharia gulumana kadhambaaka padhamo aromusakea iwe sumai, sumaimo manga mojaganina kadhambaaka bheapadhole bhatu sumai minaaka i ngangana sumu kasiimpo adhawua asumpu gulumana bhembe dumbana manga. Sapadhana sumai, bhatu bheapambulimea uka i ngangana sumu sumai.
Yakub aabhamo i manga mia incia sumai, "Manga witinaiku minaaka iapai ingkomiu sii?" Lawanimo manga incia, "Ingkami sii taminaaka i Haran."
Yakub aabha uka i manga incia, "Buaka ingkomiu umataua o Laban, opuana Nahor? "Alawanimo manga incia, "Tamataua."
Yakub aabhamo uka i manga incia, "Amalape buaka kadhaangiana?" Lawanina manga incia, "Amalape! Kamatea, kabuabua moumbana mowuluna bhembe dumbana sumaimo Rahel, o anana Laban!"
Apogaumo Yakub, "O eo indapo akonowia, indapo wakutuuna manga kadhambaakamiu uwulua ambuli i kanda. Jadi, dhawua asumpu bhembe dumba sumai, kasiimpomo uwulua pendua to apeelo kinandena."

Maka alawanimo manga incia, "Inda. Ingkami inda amembali tadhawua asumpu bhembe dumba ande indapo bhari-bharia gulumana kadhambaaka aporomusaka. Kasiimpo atopadholemo bhatu minaaka i ngangana sumu tee tadhawumea asumpu kadhambaakamami."
Tangasaana manga incia apogau, aumbamo Rahel abhawa bhembe dumbana amana, roonamo incia mojaganina.

Yakub akamata Rahel, anana Laban o witinaina inana, awulu bhembe dumbana amana. Incia apekakasumo i Rahel, kasiimpo apadholemea bhatu minaaka i ngangana sumu sumai, tee adhawumo asumpu bhembe dumbana sumai.
Sapadhana sumai, incia aikimo Rahel tee atangi tee suara makaa.
Yakub apaumbamo Rahel ande incia o anana Ribka, witinaina amana. Saanampuu abuntulimo Rahel apaumba amana.
Sarangona lelena Yakub, pinoanana, sanampuu Laban abuntulimo apokawaakea, asakua tee aikia, kasiimpo abhawea apesua i bhanuana. Yakub apetulatulaakamo bhari-bharia hali momembalina to karona i Laban.
Pogaumo Laban i incia, "Satotuuna ingkoo sadagi saraa tee iaku." Sumaimo, ambooremo Yakub tee incia sambula kangengena.
Yakub Akarajaa tee Laban to Apotibhaaka Rahel tee Lea
Kasiimpomo apogaumo Laban i Yakub "Inda apesua akala ande ukarajaa i iaku inda tee ponambo soomo rampaakana ingkoo anana witinaiku. Paumbaakaaku opea molaengana to ponambomu."
Laban dhaangia rua mia anana bhawine; o tumpe sarona Lea tee kaepu sarona Rahel.
Lea akomata makesa, maka Rahel sumai amangada poningkarona tee amakesa rouna.
Yakub asintai Rahel, sababuna sumai incia apogau, "Kupeelu kukarajaa to ingkoo pitu tao kangengena to kupotibhaaka Rahel, ana kaepumu sumai."
Alawanimo Laban, "Salabhina kudhawuaka incia to ingkoo tee aalea mia mosagaanana. Mbooremo tee iaku."
Kasiimpomo akarajaamo Yakub pitu tao kangengena to Rahel. Maka pitu tao sumai anamisia kabilanga pia-pia eomea rampaakanamo incia asintai Rahel sumai.
Sapadhana sumai apogaumo Yakub i Laban, "Dhawuakaaku momembalina bhawineku sumai, sababuna henggana wakutuuku akawamo, mamudhaakana iaku bhekukawi tee incia."
Kasiimpomo Laban akembamo bhari-bharia mia i tampa incia sumai, tee apadhaangia kariaa kawia.
Maka wakutuuna malo sumai, Laban aalamo Lea, ana tumpena, mencuana Rahel, kasiimpomo abhawamea i Yakub. Sabutuna, Yakub uka aposaangumo tee incia.
Laban adhawuaka uka samia bhatuana bhawine o sarona Zilpa i Lea to apamembalia bhatuana.

Maka wakutuuna saeona atiumbamo, garaaka bhawine ikawiakana o Lea, mencuana Rahel! Kasiimpo apogaumo Yakub i Laban, "Opea ipewaumu to iaku sii? Mboona to kupotibhaaka Rahel iaku kukarajaa to ingkoo? Pokia ingkoo ugau-gauaku?"
Alawanimo Laban, "Mencuana kananeana mia i tampamami apewau mboo sii: apakawi andina porikana kasiimpo akana.
Pamondoa porikana pitu eo kawiamu tee anaku sii. Sapadhana pitu eo sumai, bhekudhawuakako anaku samiana to ponambomu, somanamo ingkoo ukarajaa pitu taopo uka."
Sumaimo Yakub apewau mboo sumai; incia apamondoa pitu eo kawiana tee Lea, kasiimpomo Laban adhawuaka Rahel, o ana kaepuna sumai, i incia to apamembalia bhawinena.
Laban adhawuaka uka samia bhatuana bhawine o sarona Bilha i Rahel to apamembalia bhatuana.
Yakub aposaangu tee Rahel uka, tee incia alabhi asintai Rahel minaaka i Lea. Mboomo sumai incia akarajaa uka i Laban pitu taopo uka.
Manga Anana Nabii Yakub
Wakutuuna KAWASANA OPU akamata, ande Lea inda atosintai, abungkaleakea kadhumana, maka Rahel akomba.
Lea abhawa-bhawamo, kasiimpo apalaahirimo samia ana umane, tee asarongiakea Ruben,
sababuna pogauna, "Satotuuna, KAWASANA OPU padhamo akamata kanarakaaku; sii-sii tantumo iaku bheasintaiaku umaneku."

Abhawa-bhawamo uka incia, kasiimpomo apalaahirimo samia anaana umane, sumaimo incia apogau, "Satotuuna, KAWASANA OPU padhamo arangoa, ande iaku inda kusintaia, kasiimpo adhawuakamea uka ana sii i iaku." Sumaimo incia asarongiakea anana sumai Simeon.

Abhawa-bhawamo uka incia, kasiimpo apalaahirimo samia ana umane, maka incia apogau, "Sii-sii incana umaneku bheatobhoke tee iaku, roonamo iaku padhamo kupalaahiri talu mia anana umane to incia." Sumaimo sababuna incia asarongiakea anana sumai Lewi.
Abhawa-bhawamo uka incia, kasiimpo apalaahirimo samia anana umane, sumaimo incia apogau, "Sampearo sii bhekupuji i KAWASANA OPU." Siitumo sababuna incia asarongiakea anana sumai Yuda.
Sapadhana incia sumai incia indamo apalaahiri uka.

footnotes.text: Ruben: Saro incia sii onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼanana "kamatea, samia ana umane" atawa "padhamo akamata kanarakaaku".
Simeon: Saro incia sii o onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼana "arango."
Lewi: Saro incia sii o onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼanana "atobhoke."
Yuda: Saro incia sii onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼanana "incia bheatopuji." Incia uka isarongiaka Yehuda.
